page.notes: Marginal note "Baron. Anno 593. num. 18." is read as printed "Beron." in the scan; the first letter is doubtful, so it is marked [?]. The reference mark "P" before "Gregorius (inquit)" is doubtful and is also marked in the note. Several italic and roman words in the Greek-free Latin text are uncertain at this resolution (e.g. "qua"/"quae", "exfelui", "fruebatur") and are left as read. No Greek or Hebrew on this page. The catchword "Iccircò" is printed at the bottom right.
